lodShowcase.name: LOD showcase
lodShowcase.description: The LOD system lane by lane (docs/plans/_DONE_p351_impostor-billboard-lod.md Phase 5): each lane runs away from the start camera along -z, with an object in every level band. textureArrays.name: Texture arrays (p299)

thirdPersonGymScene.name: GYM (3rd person)
thirdPersonGymScene.description: Third-person obstacle-course/gym scene assembling every ported physics feature: ~15 imported GLBs, 6 moving platform variants, a player-controlled and a scripted dynamic character, and the physics stress-test spawner.

debugData.name: Third-person gym camera
debugData.description: Follow camera driven by createFollowObjectCameraRig (legacy gym's offset/lens settings), tracking the player-controlled character. This initial position/lookAt only matters for the first instant before the follow rig (APP_LOGIC) takes over each frame.

debugData.name: Third-person gym ambient fill
debugData.description: Low-intensity baseline fill so shadowed geometry isn't pure black — thirdPersonGymSun is the dominant light.

debugData.name: Third-person gym sun
debugData.description: Directional shadow-casting sun. scene_thirdPersonGym.ts moves it (and its target) with the player every frame, keeping this position - targetPos offset as the light direction, so the shadow frustum (sized for the play area around the player, not the whole scene, which would blur shadow resolution everywhere) follows the player instead of covering a fixed area around the origin.

exampleDebugTab.name: Example: Your own debug tab

exampleEcs.name: Example: Custom component & system
exampleEcs.description: A SPIN component of the app's own and the system that turns every entity that has it: a row of shapes, each turning about its own axis at its own speed, one of them hovering too.

exampleLod.name: Example: LOD & instancing
exampleLod.description: A field of 180 torus knots (16,384 triangles each) in one instanced LOD pool: the knot, its generated chain's simplified levels, then an octahedral impostor, one quad each, for the farthest. The LOD tab's level overlay shows which level each knot draws.

debugData.description: The DAY_SKY preset: its sun light (with a shadow that follows the camera) lights the field.

examplePhysics.name: Example: Physics

exampleQuickStart.name: Example: Quick start
exampleQuickStart.description: The smallest complete scene: a camera and two lights from JSON, a ground, and a cube with the toolkit's checkerBoard material, hovering with the toolkit's HoverEffect.

exampleSkyBox.name: Example: Sky box & day-night

debugData.name: Asteroid
debugData.description: Procedural object-space rock (no UVs): mottled colours, Worley pits, mineral speckles, bump. Every input is on colorNode, which also sets roughnessNode and normalNode; override `seed` per mesh for a different rock.

debugData.name: LOD showcase: hand-made levels
debugData.description: Lane 1 of the lodShowcase scene (p351 Phase 5): levels authored in JSON, the same sphere at fewer segments. This is the lane's first object (level 0's band); the lane places copies of this definition in the farther bands (lodShowcase/lanes/handMadeLevels.ts), so keep it at the lane's x (-12).

debugData.name: Ækasha symbol
debugData.description: The Æ glyph of the favicon, extruded with a small bevel: 1 unit high, centred on the origin, facing +z. One geometry, aekashaSymbol/aekashaSymbol. Built by devTools/toolkit/buildAekashaSymbol.ts; the pipeline keeps it Draco.

debugData.name: Asset compare
debugData.description: DAY_SKY with a low sun and no clouds: raking light shows the normal maps, the sky reflects in the metals.

debugData.name: Day-night (showcase)
debugData.description: The DAY_NIGHT preset (every p113 layer: atmosphere, sun and light, moon and light, stars and Milky Way, clouds and ground) on a 5-minute day.

debugData.name: Space
debugData.description: The SPACE preset (dense stars, two nebulae, no atmosphere) with a second, small blue sun. The primary sun's light frames its shadows on the origin, where the space demo's asteroids are.

debugData.name: LOD example sky
debugData.description: The DAY_SKY preset: its sun light (with a shadow that follows the camera) lights the field.

debugData.name: Sky box example
debugData.description: The DAY_NIGHT preset (atmosphere, sun and moon with their lights, stars and Milky Way, clouds, ground) on a two-minute day.
